items.title: Global funds turn wary of Indian stocks as AI boom draws money elsewhere
items.description: India's appeal to global fund managers is weakening amid muted corporate earnings and the lack of a major AI investment theme, pushing foreign ownership of NSE-listed companies to a 17-year low

items.title: Sebi proposes changes to derivatives settlement, closing auction timings
items.description: The regulator has floated two expiry-day settlement methodologies, two alternatives for market timings and changes to order cancellation and Iceberg orders during CAS
